data.contenido:
A Moiiz yiisa Israɛll nebã Ezipt n tall-⁠b n kẽng Sinayi tãngẽ wã. Yaa be la Wẽnnaam kõ-b a noyã. Rẽ poore, a Moiiz tʋma rap 12 tɩ b na n tɩ ges Kanaã tẽngã. La rap 10 n lebg n wa gom goam sẽn yɛɛs nebã tɩ b ra rat n leb Ezipti. Israɛll nebã sẽn pa tẽ Wẽnnaamã yĩnga, a kɩtame tɩ b yeeb rasempʋɩɩgã pʋgẽ yʋʋm 40.

Wẽnnaam wa n yãka a Zozue t’a na n lʋɩ Israɛll nebã taoor tɩ b kẽ Kanaã tẽngã pʋgẽ. A Zeova maana yel-​soalem n sõng-⁠b tɩ b reeg tẽngã. A kɩtame tɩ Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã koom yalse, la a kɩt tɩ Zeriko lalsã me lʋɩ, la a kɩt me tɩ wĩntoogã yals raar a ye tõre. Yʋʋm a yoob poore, Israɛll nebã tõog n deega Kanaã tẽngã.

Sẽn sɩng ne a Zozue, bʋ-​kaoodb n lʋɩ Israɛll nebã taoor yʋʋm kobs-​tã la pis-⁠nu la a yoob pʋgẽ. D na n goma bãmb wʋsg yelle. Wala makre, a Barake, a Zedeõ, a Zɛfte, a Samsõ la a Sãmwɛlle. D na n goma pagb kẽer me yelle, wala a Rahaabe, a Debora, a Zayɛlle, a Ruti, a Naomi la a Dalila. Yaa yʋʋm kobs-​tã la pis-⁠wɛ la a yoob pʋgẽ la yɛl nins b sẽn togs babg a tãabã pʋgẽ wã maan-​yã.

data.titulo: Rɩɩb b sẽn zɩ n yã
data.contenido:
YÃMB mii nebã sẽn wʋkd bũmb ningã bɩ? Yaa rɩɩbo. A yaa pɛɛlg faddd, n yaa zom-​zom.

Israɛll nebã sẽn yi Eziptã kiuug a ye la woto. B bee rasempʋɩɩgã pʋgẽ masã, la rɩɩb ka be ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b naag taab n yeel yaa: ‘A Zeova sã n da kʋẽ tõnd Ezipt n são. Beenẽ tõnd da rɩt n tɩgdame.’

A Zeova yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Mam na n kɩtame tɩ rɩɩb yi yĩngr n ni wa saaga.’ Sɩd me vẽkembeoogã yibeoogo, a Zeova kɩtame tɩ rɩɩb sẽn yaa pɛɛlg ni wa saaga. Israɛll nebã sẽn yã rẽ wã, b soka taab tɩ woto yaa bõe?

T’a Moiiz yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Yãoã yaa rɩɩb a Zeova sẽn kõt yãmb tɩ y rɩ.’ Israɛll nebã pʋda rɩɩbã tɩ MANN. A nooma wa maas sẽn ning sɩɩdo.

A Moiiz yeelame tɩ ned kam fãa wʋk a sẽn tõe n dɩ tɛka. Yibeoog fãa nebã ra wʋkda mannã, la wĩntoogã sã n da zẽk wʋsgo, mann ning sẽn da ket tẽngã boogdame.

A Moiiz yeelame me tɩ ned baa a ye ra bĩng mannã tɩ vẽeg beoog ye. La neb kẽer pa kelg ye. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn maan bɩ? Vẽkembeoogã, mann ning b sẽn da bĩngã põogame n kẽ zũnzũy tɩ lebg yũugu. La a Zeova ra yeelame tɩ rasem a yoob soabã, bɩ b wʋk wʋsg n bĩng vẽkembeoogã sẽn yaa rasem a yopoe soabã yĩngã, bala a ra pa na n kɩt tɩ mannã ni baraar ye. B sẽn sɩd yãk mannã n bĩng rasem a yopoe daarã yĩnga, pa põoge, la zũnzũy ka kẽ me ye. Ad woto me yaa yel-​solemde!

Yʋʋm nins fãa Israɛll nebã sẽn zĩnd rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã, a Zeova kõ-b-⁠la mannã tɩ b rɩ.Yikri 16:​1-⁠36; Sõdbo 11:​7-⁠9; Zozue 5:⁠10-⁠12. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

ISRAƐLL nebã sẽn yi Eziptã kiis a yiib loogr poore, b taa Sinayi tãngẽ wã b sẽn boond me tɩ Horɛbã. Yaa be la a Zeova sẽn gom ne a Moiiz tuugã pʋgẽ wã. Israɛll nebã zĩnda be wakat bilfu.

Israɛll nebã paa tãnga sɛɛga, t’a Moiiz rʋ tãngã. A Moiiz sẽn ta tãngã zugã, a Zeova yeel-⁠a lame t’a ratame tɩ Israɛll nebã sak a noyã la b lebg a nin-​buiidu. A Moiiz sẽn sigã, a togsa Israɛll nebã a Zeova sẽn yeel bũmb ningã. Israɛll nebã yeelame tɩ b na n saka a Zeova noyã, bala b ratame n lebg a nin-​buiidu.

Rẽ poore, a Zeova maana yel-​solemde. A kɩtame tɩ bug-​zõos yit tãngã zugu, la a kɩt tɩ saagã tãsdẽ. Sasa kãnga, a yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Mam yaa a Zeova, mam yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam, la yaa maam n yiis yãmb Ezipti.’ La a kõo bãmb no-​kãngã: ‘Ra pʋʋs-⁠y wẽnnaam dãmb a taab ye, sã n ka maam bala.’

Wẽnnaam kõo Israɛll nebã noy a wɛ n paase. Rabeem yõka nebã tɩ b yeel a Moiiz yaa: ‘Tõnd ratame tɩ fo gomd ne tõndo, bala Wẽnnaam sã n gomd ne tõndo, d yɛɛsda d na n wa ki.’

Rẽ poore, a Zeova yeela a Moiiz yaa: ‘Rʋ tãngã n kolg maam n yaas be. M na n kõ-f-⁠la kug-​wals sẽn tar mam noyã mam sẽn gʋls n dat tɩ nebã tũ wã.’ A Moiiz leb n dʋʋ tãngã zug n pa be rasem 40.

Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a Moiiz gʋls noy wʋsg n na n kõ Israɛll nebã. A leb n kõo a Moiiz kug-​wals a yiibã. Yaa kug-​wals a yiibã zut la Wẽnnaam meng gʋls noy 10 nins a sẽn da togs Israɛll nebã. B boonda no-​kãensã tɩ noy piigã.

Noy piigã yaa noy sẽn yaa kãsems la sẽn tar yõod wʋsgo. Noy a taab me la Wẽnnaam kõ Israɛll nebã. Bãmb me tara yõodo. Wala makre, noor a ye n yet woto: ‘Nong a Zeova fo Wẽnnaam ne f sũur fãa, ne f yamã fãa, ne f sɩɩgã fãa, la ne f pãngã fãa.’ T’a to yet woto: ‘Nong f to wa f menga.’ Wẽnnaam biig a Zezi Kirist yeelame tɩ noy nins a Zeova sẽn kõ Israɛll nebã sʋka, no-​kãensã b yiibã n yaa kãsems n yɩɩda. D na n wa goma Wẽnnaam biigã yelle, la a sẽn zãms nebã bũmb ningã me yelle.Yikri 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Tõodo 6:​4-⁠6; Maankʋʋre 19:⁠18; Matɩe 22:⁠36-⁠40. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

KAETO, ges-⁠y nebã sẽn maand bũmb ningã! B pʋʋsda nag-​bila. Bõe yĩng tɩ b maand woto?

A Moiiz sẽn dʋ tãngã zug n kaoosd n pa sigdã yĩnga, nebã yeelame yaa: ‘Wa-⁠y tɩ d maan wẽnnaam t’a lʋɩ d taoor n yiis-⁠d ka, bala tõnd ka mi bũmb ning sẽn maan a Moiiz ye.’

A Moiiz kẽem a Aarõ yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Bɩ y yãgs y sãnem tʋb-​londã n kõ-ma.’ A Aarõ reega sãnem tʋb-​londã n maan nag-​bila. Rẽ poore, nebã yeelame yaa: ‘Yãoã yaa tõnd Wẽnnaam sẽn yiis tõnd Ezipt tẽngã.’ Israɛll nebã maana kibs kãseng n waoog sãnem nag-​bilã.

A Zeova sẽn yã rẽ wã, a sũurã yikame t’a yeel a Moiiz yaa: ‘Kẽng n sig tao-​tao tɩ nebã maanda sẽn yaa wẽnga. B basa mam noyã n wõgemd sãnem nag-​bil taoore.’ A Moiiz yɩɩ tao-​tao n sigi. A sẽn wa n kolgdẽ wã, a yãa nebã sẽn yɩɩnd la b saood n gilgd sãnem nag-​bilã. A Moiiz sũurã puuga wʋsg t’a rɩk kug-​wals nins Wẽnnaam sẽn da kõ-a wã n lob tẽng tɩ kell n wã zõg-​zõge. A rɩka sãnem nag-​bilã me n yẽneg n sãam-⁠a zãng-​zãnga.

Nebã sẽn da maand bũmb ningã yaa wẽng wʋsgo. Rẽ n so t’a Moiiz yeel rap kẽer tɩ b rɩk b sʋʋsã n kʋ neb nins sẽn da waoog sãnem nag-​bilã. Neb tus a tãab n ki baraarã. Kiba-​kãngã wilgdame tɩ d segd n waooga Wẽnnaam a Zeova a ye tãa. Bala sẽn ket-​bã fãa pa wẽnnaam dãmb sɩd-​sɩd ye.Yikri 32:​1-⁠35. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii bũmb ning sẽn be fotã zugã bɩ? Yaa fu-​roog b sẽn ti a Zeova waoogr yĩnga. B boond-⁠a lame tɩ sɛk-​roogo. Yaa Israɛll nebã sẽn yi Eziptã yʋʋmd a ye poor la b maan-⁠a n sa. Yaa ãnd n yeel tɩ b maan sɛk-​roogã?

Yaa a Zeova. A Moiiz sẽn wa n dʋ Sinayi tãngã, a Zeova wilg-⁠a-⁠la a sẽn segd n maan sɛk-​roogã to-⁠to. A yeelame tɩ b maan-⁠a tɩ b tõe n siig-⁠a, n wʋk a teedã n le tɩ tilg-⁠a zĩig a to nana-​nana. Woto, Israɛll nebã sẽn wa n be rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã, b sã n wa yik n na n toeem zĩig fãa, b siigda sɛk-​roogã n tall n looge.

Y sã n ges ro-​bilã sẽn be goabgã pʋgẽ, y nee koglgo. Yaa rẽ la b sẽn boond tɩ kãabg koglgã. B rɩka sãnem n maan malɛgs a yiib b sẽn boond tɩ seribẽ rãmb n ning koglgã zugu. A Moiiz sẽn da wã kug-​walsã yĩnga, Wẽnnaam leb n gʋlsa noy piigã kug-​wals paal a yiib zutu. B ning-⁠b-⁠la kãabg koglgã pʋgẽ. B ra ninga mannã me rʋk pʋgẽ n sagl kãabg koglgã pʋgẽ. Yãmb ket n tẽra mannã sẽn yaa bũmb ning bɩ?

A Zeova yãka a Moiiz kẽem a Aarõ t’a na n yɩ maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsma. Yaa yẽ n wilgd nin-​buiidã b sẽn segd n pʋʋs a Zeova to-⁠to. A kom-​dibli wã me yaa maan-​kʋʋdba.

Ges-⁠y ro-​bedrã pʋgẽ masã. A bedrmã taa ro-​bilã naoor a yiibu. Yãmb nee kogl-​bilã sẽn dɩg tɩ bug-​zõos yit a pʋgẽ wã bɩ? Yaa tẽn-​kugrã. Beenẽ la maan-​kʋʋdbã yõogd wisdã. Fɩtl dogend sẽn tar fɩtl a yopoe me n dɩg roogã pʋgẽ. Sẽn paas me, tabl n dɩg tɩ bur 12 rog a zugu. Rʋg-​bedr n pid ne koom n dɩg yɩnga, tɩ maan-​kʋʋdbã pekd b nusã la b waasd b naoã be. Tẽn-​kug-​bedr me n be yɩngã. B koota rũmsã n yõogd beenẽ n kõt a Zeova. Israɛll nebã tii b fu-​rotã n karg n gũbg sɛk-​roogã t’a be sʋka.Yikri 25:​8-⁠40; 26:​1-⁠37; 27:​1-⁠8; 28:⁠1; 30:​1-⁠10, 17-⁠21; 34:​1, 2; Hebre dãmba 9:​1-⁠5. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y rap a yiibã sẽn zãad bũmb ninsã. Yaa sib-​gĩnd sẽn yaa bedre, kankama la grenadinni. Da yaa zɩsgo, hal tɩ yɩ tɩlae tɩ b yagl raoog zugu, tɩ rap a yiib rɩk n palg b bãgdẽ. La woto fãa yii yɛ? Yii Kanaã. Tẽeg-⁠y t’a Abrahaam, a Izaak la a Zakoob ra zĩnda Kanaã. La komã yĩng n kɩt t’a Zakoob ne a zakã rãmb yik n kẽng Ezipti. Wakat kãng n tãag masã yaa yʋʋm kobs-⁠yi la piig la a yoobe. A Moiiz peegda Israɛll nebã masã n debd Kanaã. B taa rasempʋɩɩgã zĩig ning b sẽn boond tɩ Kadɛsã.

Nin-​wẽns n vɩ Kanaã tẽngã pʋgẽ. Rẽ n so t’a Moiiz tʋm rap 12 tɩ b tɩ soos n ges tẽngã. A yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Kẽng-⁠y n tɩ ges-⁠y neb nins sẽn vɩ be wã sã n yaa wʋsgo, la b sã n tara pãnga. Ges-⁠y tẽngã sã n sakda koodo, la y zã tɩɩsã biis n wa.’

Rapã sẽn kẽng n lebg n wa, b yeela a Moiiz tɩ tẽngã yaa sõma hal wʋsgo. B zãa tɩɩsã biisã meng n wa wilg a Moiizi. La rap piig la a yiibã sʋka, bãmb 10 n baas n yeel woto: ‘Tẽngã nebã yaa nin-​wogdo, la b tara pãng me. Tõnd sã n mak n na n deeg tẽngã, b na n kʋʋ tõndo.’

Israɛll neb a taabã sẽn wʋm woto wã, b yɛɛsame n yeel yaa: ‘Tõnd fãa sã n da ki Ezipti, bɩ d sã n da ki weoogã pʋgẽ ka n são. Tẽngã neb na n kʋʋ tõndo, la b yõg d pagbã ne d kambã n looge. Bɩ d bas a Moiiz la d yãk ned a to t’a lʋɩ d taoore, tɩ d leb Ezipti.’

La rap 12 wã sʋka, a yiib n da teeg a Zeova. Yaa a Zozue ne a Kalɛɛb. B yeela Israɛll nebã yaa: ‘Ra zoe-⁠y rabeem ye. A Zeova bee ne tõndo. D na n deega tẽngã nana-​nana.’ La nebã pa kelg-⁠b ye. B ra rat n kʋʋ a Zozue ne a Kalɛɛb menga.

A Zeova sũurã puuga wʋsgo, t’a yeel a Moiiz yaa: ‘Israɛll neb nins sẽn tar yʋʋm pisi la sẽn yɩɩd woto wã baa a ye ka na n kẽ Kanaã tẽngã pʋgẽ ye. B yãa bõn-​bãn nins mam sẽn maan Ezipt ne weoogã pʋgẽ wã, la b baas n ket n pa tẽed maam ye. B fãa na n yeeba rasempʋɩɩgã pʋgẽ yʋʋm 40 n wa ki. Yaa a Zozue ne a Kalɛɛb bal n na n kẽ Kanaã.’Sõdbo 13:​1-⁠33; 14:​1-⁠38. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y rasaar sẽn ning puud la sẽn wom biisi. Yaa a Aarõ rasaare. A toba vãad n ning puud n wẽneg n wom biis yʋng a ye bala. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ woto maanã.

Israɛll nebã sẽn sɩng n yeebd rasempʋɩɩgã pʋgẽ wã kaoosa bilf masã. B neb kẽer n pa tẽed t’a Moiiz n segd n lʋɩ b taoore, la t’a Aarõ n segd n yɩ maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsem ye. Yaa a Koore, a Datã, a Abiram la Israɛll nin-​kãsems kobs-⁠yi la pis-⁠nu wã n tagsd woto. B naaga taab n wa yeel a Moiiz yaa: ‘Fo zẽkda f meng wʋsgo.’

A Moiiz yeela a Koore ne a nebã yaa: ‘Beoog yibeoogo, bɩ y rɩk wisd yõogr laas n ning wisd n wa a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã, tɩ d ges a Zeova sẽn na n yãk ned ninga.’

Beoogã sẽn vẽege, a Koore ne a neb 250 waa sɛk-​roogẽ wã. Neb wʋsg me n tũ n wa n na n sõng-⁠ba. A Zeova sũurã puuga wʋsgo. A Moiiz yeela nebã yaa: ‘Bɩ y zãag ne nin-​wẽn-​kãensã roto, la y ra sɩɩs b bũmb ba a yembr ye.’ Nebã kelga a Moiiz n zãag ne a Koore, a Datã la a Abiram dãmb fu-​rotã.

Rẽ poore, a Moiiz yeela woto: ‘Ad bũmb ninga sẽn na n wilg a Zeova sẽn yãk ned ninga. Tẽngã na n yaaga a noor n vel nin-​wẽn-​kãensã.’

A Moiiz sẽn gom n sa wã bal la tẽngã sẽn pãrge, t’a Koore zakã neb ne b teedã fãa, n paas a Datã ne a Abiram la neb nins fãa sẽn da be ne-​bã sʋʋg be. Nebã sẽn wʋm tẽngã sẽn vel-⁠b rãmbã kelemsã, bãmb me kelemame n yeel yaa: ‘D zoe tɩ tẽngã tõe n vela tõnd me.’

La a Koore ne a neb kobs-⁠yi la pis-⁠nu wã ra ket n bee sɛk-​roogã sɛɛgẽ. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ bugum sig n dɩ-⁠ba. Rẽ poore, a yeela a Aarõ biig a Eleazaar t’a rɩk a Koore ne a nebã wisd laas n kud tɩ lebg paklga, n dɩk n tabl tẽn-​kugrã. Woto ra na n tẽegda Israɛll nebã tɩ yaa a Aarõ ne a kom-​dibli wã bal n segd n yɩ a Zeova maan-​kʋʋdba.

A Zeova ra ratame n maan bũmb a to n wilg nebã vẽeneg tɩ yaa a Aarõ ne a kom-​dibli wã bal la yẽ yãk-​yã. A yeela a Moiiz yaa: ‘Kɩt tɩ buud piig la a yiibã naab fãa wa ne rasaare. A Aarõ na n waa ne rasaar Levi buudã yĩnga. Bɩ f bĩng rasabã kãabg koglgã taoore, sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ. Mam sẽn yãk a soab t’a yɩ maan-​kʋʋdã rasaar na n tobame.’

A Moiiz sẽn yik vẽkembeoogã yibeoogo, a mikame t’a Aarõ rasaarã ninga puud la a wom biisi. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zeova maan t’a Aarõ rasaarã ning puudã masã bɩ?Sõdbo 16:​1-⁠35; 17:​2-⁠26; 26:⁠10, 11. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

MAANA yʋʋm 39 tɩ Israɛll nebã ket n gilgd rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã. Yʋʋm kãensã fãa pʋgẽ, a Zeova gesa b yelle. A kõ-b-⁠la maanã tɩ b rɩ. Wĩndga, a kɩtdame tɩ sawad-​taok lʋɩ b taoor n yãagd-⁠ba. La yʋngo, sawad-​taokã lebgda bugum n kõt-⁠b vẽenem. La yʋʋmã fãa pʋsẽ, b futã ka ki, b naoã ka mod me.

Israɛll nebã sẽn yi Eziptã taa yʋʋm 40 masã. B yeeba rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã n lebg n wa Kadɛs yɛsa. Yaa be la b sẽn da kɩt tɩ rap 12 wã yi n tɩ ges Kanaã tẽngã sẽn na maan yʋʋm 40 masã wã. A Moiiz kẽem a Miryam kii Kadɛse. La wala d sẽn na n yã wã, yell n maan ka me.

Nebã yẽgmame, bala b ra pa tar koom n na n yũ ye. B yeela a Moiiz yaa: ‘Tõnd sã n da ki n são. Bõe yĩng tɩ fo yiis tõnd Ezipt n wa zĩ-wẽng kãngã pʋgẽ? A ka zĩig ned sẽn tõe n ko la a sel viyn ne grenadin tɩɩs la kankams ye. Koom meng ka be n na n yũ ye.’

A Moiiz ne a Aarõ kẽnga sɛk-​roogẽ wã n tɩ pʋʋs a Zeova t’a yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Tigm-⁠y nebã pĩ-kãngã taoore, n gom ne pĩigã bãmb nifẽ tɩ koom yi wʋsg tɩ nebã ne b rũmsã fãa paam n yũ.’

La a Moiiz tigma nebã n yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Tõatbã, kelg-⁠y-​yã. Yãmb datame tɩ maam ne a Aarõ kɩt tɩ koom yi pĩ-kãngã pʋgẽ n kõ yãmb bɩ?’ A Moiiz zẽka a dasaarã n wẽ pĩigã naoor a yiibu. La koom n pusg n yi wʋsg tɩ nebã ne b rũmsã na n paam n yũ.

La a Zeova sũurã puuga ne a Moiiz la ne a Aarõ. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ? A Moiiz ne a Aarõ yeelame tɩ yaa bãmb n na n kɩt tɩ koomã yi pĩigã pʋgẽ. Yaool n yaa a Zeova n kɩt tɩ koomã yi. A Moiiz ne a Aarõ sẽn pa togs sɩdã yĩnga, a Zeova yeelame t’a na n sɩbg-⁠b lame. A yeel-⁠b lame tɩ ka bãmb n na n tall Israɛll nebã n kẽes Kanaã tẽngã pʋgẽ ye.

Rẽ poor bilfu, Israɛll nebã yii Kadɛs. Rasem a wãn poore, b taa Hor tãngẽ wã. A Aarõ rʋʋ tãngã zug n ki be. A ra tara yʋʋm koabg la pisi la a tãabo. Israɛll nebã sũur sãamame tɩ b yãb rasem 30. A Aarõ bi-​ribl a Eleazaar n lebg Israɛll maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsma.Sõdbo 20:​1-⁠13, 22-⁠29; Tõodo 29:⁠4; Nehemi 9:⁠21. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

WAAF ning sẽn vil raoogã pa waaf sɩd-​sɩd ye. B maan-⁠a-⁠la ne zũudu. A Zeova yeela a Moiiz t’a rɩk waaf ning a sẽn maan ne zũudã n vil raoog zugu, tɩ nebã zẽk b nens n ges-⁠a sẽn na yɩl n da ki ye. La wiis nins sẽn be tẽngã yaa wiis sɩd-​sɩda. B kɛɛ nebã tɩ b lebg bãad rãmba. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ?

Yaa Israɛll nebã sẽn kɩɩs Wẽnnaam ne a Moiizã yĩnga. B yeelame yaa: ‘Yaa bõe tɩ y yiis tõnd Ezipt tɩ d wa ki weoogã pʋgẽ? Rɩɩb ne koom kae ye. La tõnd yam yii ne mannã.’

Mannã yaool n da yaa rɩ-​noogo. A Zeova maana yel-​solemd tɩ b paam dẽ n dɩtẽ. A ra leb n maana yel-​solemd tɩ b paam koom n na n yũ. La Israɛll nebã ka pʋʋs Wẽnnaam bark rẽ fãa yĩng ye. Rẽ n so t’a Zeova tʋm wag-​toos tɩ b wa kɛ-⁠b tɩ wʋsg ki.

La Israɛll nebã wa n yeela a Moiiz yaa: ‘Tõnd kongame. Bala, tõnd goma a Zeova ne foo wẽnga. Bɩ f pʋʋs a Zeova t’a yiis wag-​toosã tõnd sʋka.’ A Moiiz pʋʋsa nebã yĩnga, t’a Zeova yeel-⁠a t’a maan waaf ne zũud n vil raoog zugu, tɩ waaf sẽn kɛ ned ning fãa bɩ a soab zẽk a neng n gese. A Moiiz maana Wẽnnaam sẽn yeelã. Wiisã sẽn kɛ neb ninsã sã n zẽk b nens n ges waaf sẽn maan ne zũudã bala, b sãoogdame.

Kiba-​kãngã zãmsda tõnd bũmbu. Tõnd me wõnda Israɛll nebã wiisã sẽn da kɛ tɩ b kiidẽ wã. Yãmb sã n gese, nebã bẽedame, n kʋʋndẽ la b kiidẽ. Yaa a Ãdem ne a Hawa sẽn kɩɩs a Zeova noorã tɩ tõnd yaool n yaa b kambã yĩnga. La a Zeova maana bũmb n na n fãag-⁠do.

A Zeova tʋma a biig a Zezi Kirist t’a wa tẽngã zugu. B kaa a Zezi raoog zugu, bala neb wʋsg ra tẽedame t’a pa nin-​sõng ye. La a Zeova tʋma a Zezi t’a wa fãag-⁠do. D sã n sak-⁠a la d tũ-a, d na n paama vɩɩm sẽn ka sate. D na n wa goma rẽ yell n paase.Sõdbo 21:​4-⁠9; Zã 3:⁠14, 15. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB zoe n wʋma bõang sẽn gomd bɩ? Yaa vẽeneg tɩ y zɩ n wʋme, bala rũmsã pa gomd ye. La Biiblã wilgdame tɩ bõang a ye n gome. Bɩ d ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.

Israɛll nebã ra kolga Kanaã tẽngã n dat n kẽ. La Moaab rĩm a Balak ra zoeta Israɛll nebã, b sẽn yaa wʋsgã yĩnga. A kɩtame tɩ b bool sɩlem soab a ye sẽn boond t’a Balaam, t’a na n kãab Israɛll nebã wẽnga. A Balak yeela a Balaam t’a sã n tõoge, a na n kõ-a-⁠la ligd wʋsgo. A Balaam sɩd zomba a bõangã n na n kẽng a Balak nengẽ.

La a Zeova ra pa rat t’a Balaam kãab a nebã wẽng ye. Rẽ n so t’a tʋm malɛk ne sʋ-​wok t’a na n gɩd a Balaam sorã zugu. A Balaam ra pa ne malɛkã ye. La a bõangã yẽ ra ne-⁠a lame. Rẽ n so tɩ bõangã bao n na n lak n bas sorã, n wa mak n kong n gãand sorã zugu. A Balaam sũurã puugame t’a na n pãb bõangã ne rasaare.

A Zeova kɩtame tɩ bõangã gom ne a Balaam. A yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Mam maana yãmb bõe tɩ yãmb pãbd maam woto?’

A Balaam leoka bõangã yaa: ‘Yaa fo sẽn lebg tõatã. M sã n da tar sʋʋga m kodgd-⁠f lame.’

Tɩ bõangã yeel yaa: ‘Mam zoe n maana yãmb woto sɩda?’

T’a Balaam leok tɩ ayo.

T’a Zeova na n yaool n kɩt t’a Balaam yã malɛkã sẽn yas sorã zug ne sʋʋga. Malɛkã yeela a Balaam yaa: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ fo pãbd bõangã? Mam waame n na n gɩd foo tɩ f ra tɩ kãab Israɛll nebã wẽng ye. Fo bõangã sã n da pa lak n bas sorã, m da na n kʋ-⁠f lame la m bas bõangã.’

T’a Balaam yeel yaa: ‘Mam kongame. M da pa mi tɩ foo n yas sorã zug ye.’ Malɛkã basa a Balaam t’a looge. La a Balaam kẽnga a Balak nengẽ. A baas n makame n na n kãab Israɛll nebã wẽnga, la a Zeova kɩtame t’a ning Israɛll nebã bark naoor a tãab fãa.Sõdbo 21:⁠21-⁠35; 22:​1-⁠40; 23:​1-⁠30; 24:​1-⁠25. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A MOIIZ da rat n naaga Israɛll nebã n tɩ kẽ Kanaã tẽngã pʋgẽ. A yeela a Zeova woto: ‘Mam kotame tɩ f bas maam tɩ m kẽng n tɩ ges tẽn-​neer ning sẽn be Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã poorã.’ La a Zeova leok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Ra le gom yel-​kãngã yell ne maam ye.’ Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zeova yeel woto wã bɩ?

Tẽeg-⁠y t’a Moiiz ne a Aarõ pa yeel Israɛll nebã tɩ yaa a Zeova n kɩt tɩ koomã yi pĩigã pʋgẽ ye. B yeelame tɩ yaa bãmb n maane. Dẽnd b pa waoog a Zeova ye. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a Zeova sẽn yeel tɩ b pa na n kẽ Kanaã tẽngã.

A Aarõ kũumã kiis a wãn poore, a Zeova yeela a Moiiz yaa: ‘Peeg a Zozue n kẽng n tɩ yaas maan-​kʋʋd a Eleazaar la nebã taoore, n yeel-⁠b t’a Zozue n na n lʋɩ b taoor masã.’ Wala yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã, a Moiiz kell n maana a Zeova sẽn yeel-⁠a bũmb ningã.

Rẽ poore, a Zeova yeela a Zozue yaa: ‘Nang pãnga, keng f sũuri. Tɩ bõe, yaa foo n na n tall Israɛll nebã n kẽ tẽng ninga mam sẽn da wẽen tɩ mam na n kõo bãmbã. La mam bee ne foom.’

Rẽ poore, a Zeova yeela a Moiiz t’a rʋ tãng ning sẽn be Moaab tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ b boond tɩ Nebo wã zugu. A sẽn dʋ wã, a yãa Kanaã tẽngã sẽn yaa neer to-⁠to wã. A Zeova yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Tẽng ningã mam sẽn da wẽen ne a Abrahaam ne a Izaak la a Zakoob tɩ m na n kõo b yagensã la woto. Mam kɩtame tɩ f yã-a, la f pa na n kẽ a pʋgẽ ye.’

A Moiiz kii Nebo tãngã zugu. Rẽ t’a ra tara yʋʋm koabg la pisi, la a ra ket n tara pãnga, t’a ninã me ket n ne sõma. A Moiiz kũumã sãama nebã sũy wʋsg tɩ b yãbe. La b sẽn paam t’a Zozue na n lʋɩ b taoorã yɩ-⁠b-⁠la noogo.Sõdbo 27:⁠12-⁠23; Tõodo 3:⁠23-⁠29; 31:​1-⁠8, 14-⁠23; 32:⁠45-⁠52; 34:​1-⁠12. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YELL n pak rap nins sẽn be fotã zugã. B sã n pa zoe, b na n kiime. Rapã yaa Israɛll neba, la pag ning sẽn sõngd-​bã yʋʋr la a Rahaabe. A Rahaab roogã bee Zeriko lalgã zugu. Bɩ d ges yell ning sẽn pak rapã.

Israɛll nebã rat n dʋʋga Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã n kẽ Kanaã tẽngã masã. La nananda, a Zozue tʋma rap a yiibã tɩ b tɩ ges Zeriko tẽngã n bãng a sẽn yaa to-⁠to n wa togse. Rapã sẽn ta Zeriko wã, b kẽnga a Rahaab nengẽ. La ned n yã-b n tɩ togs Zeriko naabã tɩ Israɛll neb n wa baraar yʋngã n na n ges tẽngã. Naabã tʋma neb tɩ b tɩ yeel a Rahaab t’a yiis neb nins sẽn sig a zakẽ wã. La a Rahaab solga rap a yiibã a roogã zug la a yeel naabã neb yaa: ‘Yaa sɩda, neb a yiib n wa mam nengẽ, la mam ka mi b sẽn yi zĩig ning ye. Zĩigã sẽn sobg tɩ b rat n pag kʋɩlensã, rapã soosame n yi. Bɩ y zoe n babs bãmb tao-​tao tɩ y na n paam-⁠b lame.’ Naabã neb sɩd zoeeme n na n babs rap a yiibã.

B loogrã poore, a Rahaab bʋʋga rapã a roogã zug n yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Mam miime t’a Zeova na n kõo yãmb tẽn-​kãngã. Tõnd wʋma a sẽn kɩt tɩ Mog-​miuugã lebg koɛɛng wakat ning yãmb sẽn yi Ezipt tẽngã. La d wʋma yãmb sẽn kʋ Amoor nanambs a Sihõ ne a Oogã me. La masã, mam kota yãmb tɩ y wẽen tɩ y na n wa maana maam neer wa mam sẽn maan yãmb me neerã. Fãag-⁠y mam ba wã ne m ma wã, la m yapã ne m kẽem dãmbã.’

Rap a yiibã pʋlmame tɩ b na n fãag-⁠b lame, la rẽnda a Rahaab me maan bũmbu. B yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Rɩk wĩ-miu-​kãngã n loe f roogã fenetre, la f bool f ba wã ne f ma wã ne f kẽem dãmbã la f yapã, la f ba wã zakã rãmb fãa tɩ b wa tigim fo nengẽ. Dẽ, tõnd sã n lebg n wa n na n deeg Zeriko tẽngã, d sã n yã wĩirã, d pa na n kʋ neb nins sẽn be fo roogẽ wã ye.’ Rap a yiibã sẽn leb a Zozue nengẽ wã, b togs-⁠a-⁠la bũmb nins sẽn maanã fãa.Zozue 2:​1-⁠24; Hebre dãmba 11:⁠31. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-Y Israɛll nebã sẽn dʋʋgd Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã tɩ yaa koɛɛnga! Yʋʋmdã sasa kãng yaool n yaa saas wakat tɩ kʋɩlgã ra pid ne koom. La ka wã, koomã fãa loogame tɩ yaa koɛɛng tɩ Israɛll nebã tũud be n loogdẽ, wa Mog-​miuugã pɩʋʋgr sasa wã. La koomã fãa kẽe yɛ? Bɩ d gese.

Israɛll nebã sẽn wa n na n dʋʋg Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã, a Zeova kɩtame t’a Zozue yeel nebã woto: ‘Maan-​kʋʋdbã na n talla kãabg koglgã n lʋɩ yãmb taoore. B sã n sagl b naoã Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ, koomã na n yalsame.’

Maan-​kʋʋdbã rɩka kãabg koglgã n lʋɩ nebã taoore. B sẽn ta Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgẽ wã, b kell n kẽe koomã pʋgẽ. Koomã ra zoeta wʋsgo, la b sẽn sagl b naoã koomã pʋgẽ wã bal la koomã sẽn sɩd yalse. Ad yaa yel-​solemde! A Zeova kɩtame tɩ koomã sẽn da zoet n watẽ wã kell n yalse. Rẽ poor bilf bala, kʋɩlgã lebga koɛɛnga. Maan-​kʋʋdb nins sẽn da zãad kãabg koglgã tɩ yalsa kʋɩl-​koɛɛngã tẽn-​sʋka. Yãmb pa ne-⁠b fotã zug sɩda? B sẽn yals kʋɩlgã tẽn-​sʋkã, Israɛll nebã fãa tõog n pɩʋʋg n loogame. Nebã fãa sẽn pɩʋʋg n sa wã, a Zeova kɩtame t’a Zozue yeel rap 12 woto: ‘Kẽ-y kʋɩlgã sʋk n yãk kug piig la a yiib zĩig ning maan-​kʋʋdbã sẽn yasã, n tall n tɩ rʋʋg zĩig ninga yãmb sẽn na n gãand rũnda yʋngã. Yãmb kambã sã n wa sok yãmb tɩ kug kãensã võor yaa bõe, bɩ y leok-⁠b yaa: “Wakat ning b sẽn tall a Zeova kãabg koglgã n na n tɩ rʋʋg Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã, koomã yalsame. Yaa kug kãensã n na n tẽeg yãmb yel-​solem-​kãngã yell wakat fãa.” ’ A Zozue me wʋka kug 12 n tɩ rʋʋg maan-​kʋʋdbã sẽn da yas zĩig ning kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ wã.

Rẽ poore, a Zozue yeela maan-​kʋʋdb nins sẽn da zãad kãabg koglgã tɩ b yi Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ. B sẽn yi wã bal la koomã sẽn leb n sɩng zoeese.Zozue 3:​1-⁠17; 4:​1-⁠18. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

BÕE n kɩt tɩ Zeriko lalsã lʋɩtẽ? Wõnda bõmb n lʋɩ b zutu. La wakat kãng tɩ bõmb la bug-​raad meng ka be ye. Dẽnd yaa a Zeova n maan yel-​solemd tɩ lalsã lʋɩtẽ. Bɩ d ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.

A Zeova yeela a Zozue yaa: ‘Bɩ foo ne f sodaasã gilg tẽngã vugr daar fãa, tɩ ta rasem a yoobe. Zã-y kãabg koglgã n gilg tẽngã. Bɩ maan-​kʋʋdb a yopoe tall bard a yopoe n lʋɩ kãabg koglgã taoor n peebdẽ.’

‘La rasem a yopoe daarã, bɩ y gilg tẽngã naoor a yopoe. Rẽ poor bɩ maan-​kʋʋdbã peeb bardã wʋsgo, tɩ ned kam fãa zẽk a koɛɛg n kaas wʋsgo, tɩ tẽngã lalsã na n lʋɩɩme.’



A Zozue ne Israɛll nebã maana wa a Zeova sẽn yeelã. Rasem a yoobã fãa b sẽn wa n gilgd tẽngã, ned baa a ye ra pa gomd ye. Ra yaa bardã peebg la kẽnã bʋʋr bal la b wʋmda. Wẽnnaam nebã bɛɛb sẽn da be Zeriko wã segd n yɛɛsame. Yãmb nee wĩ-miuugã sẽn yag fenetrẽ wã bɩ? Yaa ãnd roog fenetre? Yaa a Rahaab. A maana rap a yiibã sẽn yeel-⁠a t’a maanã. A zakã rãmb fãa bee ne-⁠a a roogã pʋgẽ n gũudẽ.

Rasem a yopoe daarã, b sẽn gilg tẽngã naoor a yopoe wã poore, b peeba bardã tɩ sodaasã kaas tɩ lalsã lʋɩ. A Zozue yeela sodaasã yaa: ‘Kʋ-⁠y tẽngã nebã fãa, la y yõog tẽngã la bũmb nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã bugum. Tall-⁠y wanzuri wã ne sãnemã la zũudã ne kutã bal n wa a Zeova sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ, tɩ b bĩng laogã bĩngr zĩigẽ.’

A Zozue yeela rap a yiibã sẽn da wa n ges Zeriko tẽngã tɩ b kẽng a Rahaab roogẽ wã n tɩ yiis yẽ ne a buudã fãa. A Rahaab ne a zakã rãmb põsame, wa rap a yiibã sẽn da pʋlm-⁠a wã.Zozue 6:​1-⁠25. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y raoã sẽn busd bũmb ning a fu-​roogã pʋgẽ wã! Yaa fu-​neer ne sãnem gilg la wanzuri la a sẽn busdã. A rɩka te-​kãensã Zeriko. La yãmb ket n tẽra b sẽn da segd n maan bũmb ning ne Zeriko teedã bɩ?

B ra segd n yõog-⁠b lame, la b tall sãnemã ne wanzuri wã n wa a Zeova sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ, tɩ b bĩng laogã bĩngr zĩigẽ. Dẽnd ra-​kãnga ne neb nins sẽn be ne yẽ fotã zugã kɩɩsa Wẽnnaam, bala b zuu a teedo. Raoã yʋʋr la a Akã, la neb a taabã yaa a zakã rãmba. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn na n maane.

A Akã sẽn zu teedã poore, a Zozue tʋma neb tɩ b tɩ zab ne Ai tẽngã neba. La b ka tõog zabrã ye. Neb kẽer kiime tɩ sẽn kell-​bã lebg n zoe. A Zozue sũurã sãama wʋsg t’a fõgen a neng tẽng n pʋʋs a Zeova n sok-⁠a yaa: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ fo bas tɩ woto paam tõndo?’

A Zeova leok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Yiki, Israɛll nebã kongame. B rɩka bũmb nins b sẽn da segd n yõogã, la bũmb ning b sẽn da segd n tall n wa mam sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ wã. B zuu fu-​neer n solge. Yãmb sã n ka yiis nebã ne bũmb nins bãmb sẽn zuka yãmb sʋka, mam ka na n le zĩnd ne yãmb ye.’ A Zeova yeelame t’a na n wilga a Zozue ned ning sẽn maana woto wã.

A Zozue tigma nin-​buiidã, t’a Zeova yãk a Akã nebã sʋka. A Akã yeela woto: ‘Sɩda, yaa maam n beege. Mam yãa fu-​neer ne sãnem gilg la wanzuri. Bõn yõka maam, tɩ mam dɩk-⁠b n wa bus m fu-​roogã pʋgẽ.’

A Zozue sẽn tʋm tɩ b tɩ wʋk teedã n wa wã poore, a yeela a Akã yaa: ‘Yaa bõe tɩ fo bao yel-​kãngã n kõ tõndo? Rũndã, a Zeova na n kɩtame tɩ toog paam foo.’ A Zozue sẽn gom woto n sa wã, Israɛll nebã fãa loba a Akã ne a zakã rãmb ne kug tɩ b ki. Woto wilgdame tɩ d pa segd n dɩk bũmb d sẽn pa so ye.

Rẽ poore, Israɛll nebã leb n tɩ zaba ne Ai nebã. So-​kãnga, a Zeova sõnga a nin-​buiidã tɩ b tõog zabrã.Zozue 7:​1-⁠26; 8:​1-⁠29. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

KANAÃ tẽns wʋsg neb segla b mens n na n zab ne Israɛll nebã. B tẽedame tɩ b na n tõogame. La Gabaõ nebã sẽn da pẽ Israɛll nebã ra pa tẽed woto ye. B miime tɩ Wẽnnaam sõngda Israɛll nebã, la b pa rat n zab ne Wẽnnaam ye. Yãmb mii Gabaõ nebã sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ?

B maana wa bãmb sẽn vɩ zĩig ningã zãra ne Israɛll nebã sẽn beẽ wã. Bãmb kẽer yeelga fu-​kʋda, la b wid neood-​zagse. B zɩlga b bõensã yol-​kʋda, la b zɩ bur sẽn kʋɩ n puki. B sẽn ta a Zozue nengẽ wã, b yeel-⁠a-⁠la woto: ‘Tõnd yii tẽn-​zãrgẽ n wa ka, bala tõnd wʋmame tɩ b gomd yãmb Wẽnnaam a Zeova sẽn tar pãng wʋsgã yelle. Tõnd wʋma a sẽn maan bũmb ning fãa n kõ yãmb Eziptã. Tõnd taoor dãmbã yeela tõnd tɩ d zã rɩɩb d kẽndã yĩng n wa yãmb nengẽ n wa yeel-⁠y yaa: “Tõnd na n yɩɩ yãmb tʋm-​tʋmdba. La masã, bɩ y pʋlem tɩ y pa na n zab ne tõnd ye.” Yãmb pa ne tõnd futã sẽn ki tɩ d burã kʋɩ n puk sɩda?’

A Zozue ne neb a taabã tẽe Gabaõ nebã. Rẽ n so tɩ b pʋlem tɩ b pa na n zab ne-⁠b ye. La rasem a tãab loogr poore, b bãngame tɩ Gabaõ nebã ra wẽneg n yaa bãmb yagse.

A Zozue sok-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb belg tõnd tɩ yãmb yita zĩ-zãrgẽ?’

Gabaõ nebã leokame yaa: ‘Tõnd wʋmame tɩ yãmb Wẽnnaam a Zeova kãabame t’a n na n kõo yãmb Kanaã tẽngã fãa. Tõnd ra yɛɛsdame tɩ yãmb na n wa kʋʋ tõndo. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ tõnd maan woto.’ La Israɛll nebã kell n pidsa b pʋlengã n pa kʋ Gabaõ nebã ye. B kɩtame tɩ b lebg b tʋm-​tʋmdba.

La Zerizalɛm rĩmã sẽn wʋm tɩ Gabaõ nebã yõga zood ne Israɛll nebã, a sũurã puugame t’a yeel nanambs a naas tɩ b wa sõng-⁠a t’a zab ne Gabaõ nebã. Nanambs a nu wã sɩd naaga taab n na n wa zab ne Gabaõ nebã. Yaa Gabaõ nebã sẽn yõg zood ne Israɛll nebã n kɩt tɩ rĩm dãmbã yik n dat n zab ne-​bã. Rẽ yĩnga Gabaõ nebã sẽn maanã yaa bũmb sẽn zems bɩ? Bɩ d ges sẽn pʋgdã.Zozue 9:​1-⁠27; 10:​1-⁠5. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y a Zozue. A gomda ne wĩndgã n yetẽ yaa: ‘Wĩndga, yalse!’ Wĩntoogã sɩd yalsa zug tẽn-​sʋk raarã tõre. Yaa a Zeova n maan woto. D ges bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zozue ra rat tɩ wĩntoogã yalsã.

Kanaã nanambs a nu wã sẽn wa n naag taab n na n zab ne Gabaõ nebã, Gabaõ nebã tʋma ned t’a tɩ yeel a Zozue yaa: ‘Wa-⁠y tao-​tao n wa fãag-⁠do. Nanambs nins sẽn be tãensã sʋkã tigma taab n dat n zab ne yãmb tʋm-​tʋmdbã.’

Tao-​tao bala, a Zozue ne a sodaasã fãa yikame n na n kẽnge. B kẽna yʋng tõre. B sẽn wa n ta Gabaõ wã, nanambs a nu wã sodaas yɛɛsame n sɩng zoeese. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ sapɩlem bɛd rʋʋg n pãb-⁠b hal tɩ b ki. Sapɩlmã sẽn kʋ neb ninsã yaa wʋsg n yɩɩd a Zozue sodaasã sẽn kʋ wã.

La a Zozue wa n yãame tɩ wĩntoogã rat n kẽeme. A sã n yaool n kẽ tɩ zĩigã sobge, nanambs a nu wã sodaas wʋsg na n paam n zoe n põsame. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a Zozue sẽn pʋʋs a Zeova la a yeel wĩntoogã t’a yalsã. Wĩntoogã sɩd yalsame, tɩ b paam n zab zabrã n tõoge.

Nanambs a taab me n be Kanaã tẽngẽ wã n kis Wẽnnaam nin-​buiidã. A Zozue ne a sodaasã rɩka yʋʋm a yoob n na n zab ne nanambs 31 n tõoge. Rẽ poore, a Zozue pʋɩya Kanaã tẽngã tɩ Israɛll buud nins sẽn da pa tar zĩisã paame.

Yʋʋm wʋsg loogr poore, a Zozue kiime. A ra tara yʋʋm koabg la piiga. Yẽ ne a zo-​rãmbã sẽn da ket n vɩ wã sasa, Israɛll nebã ra tũuda a Zeova noyã. La bãmb fãa sẽn wa n ki wã, nebã yikame n maand sẽn yaa wẽnga, tɩ zu-​loees paam-⁠ba. Rẽndame tɩ Wẽnnaam sõng-⁠ba.Zozue 10:​6-⁠15; 12:​7-⁠24; 14:​1-⁠5; Bʋkaoodba 2:​8-⁠13. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

ISRAƐLL nebã sẽn wa n tar zu-​loeesã, b kelmame n bõos a Zeova t’a sõng-⁠ba. A Zeova yãka neb sẽn tar raood tɩ b lʋɩ b taoor n sõng-⁠ba. Biiblã boonda nin-​kãens tɩ bʋ-​kaoodba. A Zozue n yɩ pipi bʋ-​kaooda. A kũumã poore, neb a taab me n yɩ bʋ-​kaoodba. Wala makre, d tõe n sõdga a Otniɛll, a Ehud ne a Sãmgaar. La pagb a yiib me n sõng Israɛll nebã. Yaa a Debora ne a Zayɛlle. A Debora yɩɩ no-​rɛɛsa. A Zeova ra wilgda pʋg-​kãngã bũmb ning sẽn na n maane, t’a togsd nebã. A Debora ra leb n yaa bʋ-​kaooda. A ra zĩi koang tẽngre, tɩ nebã wat n togsd b yɛlã t’a sõngd-⁠ba.

Wakat kãng tɩ ra yaa a Zabẽ n yaa Kanaã naaba. A ra tara kut saar dãmb kobs-⁠wɛ. A sodaasã sẽn da waoogã yĩnga, Israɛll nebã kong n lebga a yembse. A Zabẽ sodaasã naab yʋʋr la a Sizera.

Daar a yembre, a Debora boola bʋ-​kaood a Barak n yeel-⁠a t’a Zeova yeelame t’a tigim neb tus piig n kẽng Taboor tãngẽ wã, t’a na n kɩtame t’a tõog a Sizera ne a sodaasã.

A Barak yeela a Debora yaa: ‘Yãmb sã n yãag maam, mam na n kẽngame.’ A Debora yãag-⁠a lame, la a yeel-⁠a-⁠la woto: ‘Ka foo n na n kɩt tɩ b tõog ye, bala a Zeova na n kɩtame tɩ pag tõog a Sizera.’ Sɩd yɩɩ woto.

A Barak siga Taboor tãngã n na n sɛg a Sizera sodaasã. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ saag ni wʋsg zĩig pʋgẽ, tɩ koomã rɩ a Sizera sodaas wʋsgo. La a Sizera siga a saarã zug n zoe.

A Sizera zoeeme n ta a Zayɛll fu-​roogẽ wã, t’a Zayɛll yeel-⁠a t’a kẽ. A kõ-a-⁠la bĩisim t’a yũ, la a sẽn yũ wã a sɩnga suusgu, n wa gũsi. A Zayɛll rɩka a fu-​roogã kãntĩig a ye ne marto n ka a Sizera zugã t’a ki. A Barak sẽn wa n ta wã, a Zayɛll wilg-⁠a-⁠la a Sizera sẽn ki n dɩga. Dẽnd a Debora sẽn yeel bũmb ningã sɩd pidsame.

B wa n kʋʋ naab a Zabẽ me, tɩ Israɛll nebã tõog n le paam laafɩ.Bʋkaoodba 2:⁠14-⁠22; 4:​1-⁠24; 5:​1-⁠31. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A Rut ne a Naomi kibare
data.contenido:
SEBR a ye n be Biiblã pʋgẽ tɩ b boond tɩ Rut sebre. Seb-​kãng gomda zak a ye neb sẽn zĩnd Israɛll bʋ-​kaoodbã sasa yelle. A Rut ra yaa Moaab neda. A ra pa Israɛll ned ye. La a sẽn wa n bãng tɩ yaa a Zeova la Wẽnnaam sɩd-​sɩdã, a sũur yɩɩ noog t’a sak n na n tũ-a ne a sũur fãa. Yaa pʋg-​yãang a Naomi n sõng a Rut t’a bãng a Zeova.

A Naomi yaa Israɛll neda. Kom n wa n kẽ Israɛlle, tɩ yẽ ne a sɩdã la b kom-​dibli a yiibã yik n kẽng Moaab tẽngẽ wã. La a Naomi sɩdã wa n kiime. A kom-​dibli wã kẽe kãadem ne Moaab kom-​pugli, a Rut ne a Orpa. La yʋʋm 10 poore, a Naomi kom-​dibli wã me kiime. A Naomi ne a bi-​pagb a yiibã sũur sãamame. Bõe la a Naomi na n maan masã?

Raar a yembre, a Naomi yikame n na n leb a tẽngẽ wã Israɛlle. Zĩigã ra zãra wʋsgo. A Rut ne a Orpa me yikame n na n tũ-a. B sẽn wa n kẽnd n kẽndã, a Naomi wẽnegame n yeel a bi-​pagbã yaa: ‘Lebg-⁠y n kul-⁠y n tɩ zĩnd ne y ma rãmba.’

A mobg-⁠b lame la a pʋʋs-⁠b wẽnd-⁠na-​taase. La a Rut ne a Orpa sɩnga yãbre, bala b ra nonga a Naomi wʋsgo. B yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Ayo, tõnd na n tũu foo n kuli.’ La a Naomi yeelame yaa: ‘Lebg-⁠y n kul-⁠y tɩ rẽ n são, m kamba.’ A Orpa lebgame n kuisẽ la a Rut yẽ pa lebg ye.

A Naomi wẽnegame n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘A Orpa lebgame n kuisẽ. Tũ-a tɩ y kuli.’ La a Rut yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Da pẽdg maam tɩ m lebg n bas foom ye. Tɩ bõe, zĩig ninga fo sẽn na n kẽngã, mam me na n kẽnga be, la zĩig ninga fo sẽn na n sigã, mam me na n siga be. Fo nebã na n yɩɩ mam neba, la fo Wẽnnaamã me na n yɩɩ mam Wẽnnaam. Zĩig ninga fo sẽn na n ki wã, mam me na n kii be, la b na n muma maam beenẽ.’ A Rut sẽn gom woto wã, a Naomi pa le modg-⁠a t’a lebg n kul ye.

A Naomi ne a Rut taa Israɛll n na n zĩnd be. A Rut kell n sɩnga tʋʋm pʋtã pʋsẽ, bala ra yaa ki wã kẽebg sasa. Rao a ye yʋʋr sẽn yaa a Boaaz n sak t’a na n yiis ki wã a pʋtã pʋsẽ. Yãmb mii a Boaaz ma sẽn yaa ned ning bɩ? Yaa a Rahaab sẽn da yit Zeriko wã.

Raar a yembre, a Boaaz yeela a Rut yaa: ‘Mam wʋma fo yelle, la bũmb nins fãa fo sẽn maan n sõng a Naomi wã. Mam miime tɩ fo basa f ba ne f ma la f meng tẽng n wa n na n zĩnd ne buud ninga fo sẽn ka mi. Bɩ a Zeova rol foom f tʋʋmdã zãnga.’

A Rut leok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo yaa nin-​sõng wʋsgo. Fo goamã belsa maam.’ A Boaaz ra nonga a Rut wʋsgo. Pa yã n kaoos la b kẽ kãadem ne taab ye. A Naomi sũurã segd n yɩɩ noog koe! A Rut ne a Boaaz roga b pipi bi-​riblã n pʋd a yʋʋr t’a Obɛd. A Naomi sũurã yɩɩ noog n paase. A Obɛd yaa a Davɩɩd yaab-​raoogo. D na n wa goma a Davɩɩd yelle.Rut sak a 1 n tɩ tãag a 4. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB nee rapã fotã zug bɩ? Yaa Israɛll sodaase. Rap nins sẽn zõrã yũuda koom. Rao ning sẽn yas b poorẽ wã yaa bʋ-​kaood a Zedeõ. A geta b sẽn yũud koomã to-⁠to wã.

Ges-⁠y nebã sẽn yũud koomã to-⁠to. Kẽer fõgna b nensã koomẽ wã n yũuda. La ned a ye n kaag koomã ne a nug n nak a neng n getẽ la a yũuda. A sẽn yũud to-⁠to wã yaa sõma, bala a Zeova yeela a Zedeõ t’a yãk rap nins sẽn na n getẽ la b yũudã bala, la a kɩt tɩ neb a taabã lebg n kuli. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zeova yeel woto wã.

Israɛll nebã le tara zu-​loeese, bala b pa tũ a Zeova noyã ye. Madiã nebã soog-⁠b lame n namsd-⁠b wʋsgo. Rẽ n so tɩ b bõos a Zeova t’a sõng-⁠ba, t’a Zeova sake.

A Zeova yeela a Zedeõ t’a tigim sodaase. A Zedeõ tigma bãmb tus pis-​tã la a yiibu. Yaool n yaa sodaas tus koabg la tus pis-​tã la a nu n da rat n zab ne Israɛll nebã. La a Zeova yeela a Zedeõ t’a sodaasã yaa wʋsgo. Bõe yĩng t’a Zeova yet woto?

Bala Israɛll nebã sã n tõog zabrã, b na n wa tagsame tɩ yaa ne bãmb meng pãng la b sẽn tõogã. B tõe n wa tẽedame t’a Zeova sõngr ka tɩlae ye. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a Zeova yeel a Zedeõ yaa: ‘Moon koɛɛg n yeel nebã tɩ rabeem sẽn tar-⁠a soab t’a rigd bɩ a kul a yiri.’ A Zedeõ sẽn yeel woto wã, sodaas tus pisi la a yiib n lebg n kuli. Ra keta sodaas tus piig bal sẽn segd n zab ne sodaas tus koabg la tus pis-​tã la a nu.

La a Zeova yeelame t’a Zedeõ sodaasã ket n yaa wʋsgo. A yeela a Zedeõ t’a kɩt t’a sodaasã tɩ yũ koom kʋɩlgẽ wã, la a kɩt tɩ neb nins sẽn na n fõgen b nensã koomẽ wã n yũ wã lebg n kuli. Yaa sodaas kobs-​tã bal n da nak b neng n getẽ la b yũuda. La a Zeova yeelame t’a na n kɩtame t’a Zedeõ ne sodaas kobs-​tã wã tõog zabrã. Zabrã daar sẽn ta wã, a Zedeõ pʋɩya a sodaasã zĩis a tãabo. A kõo bãmb ned kam fãa baorg ne rʋg-​vɩʋʋgo, tɩ bug-​vɩleng sag a pʋgẽ. Yʋn-​sʋkã sẽn ta, yẽ ne a sodaasã karg n gũbga Madiã sodaasã sikã zĩiga. B fãa naaga taab n peeb b bardã, n wẽ rʋgdã n wã la b kelem tɩ: ‘Sʋʋgã yaa a Zeova ne a Zedeõ n so.’ Madiã sodaasã nekame n yɛɛs n pa mi b sẽn maand ye. B fãa sɩnga zoeese, tɩ Israɛll nebã tõog zabrã.Bʋkaoodba sak a 6 n tɩ tãag a 8. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB zoe n pʋlma ned bũmb n wa mik tɩ yaa toog tɩ y pids y pʋlengã bɩ? A buud n paam rao ning yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã. Yaa rẽ la a sũurã sẽn pa noomã. A ra yaa Israɛll bʋ-​kaood sẽn tar raood wʋsgo. A yʋʋr la a Zɛfte.

A Zɛfte wakatẽ wã tɩ Israɛll nebã ra basa a Zeova n tũud wẽnnaam dãmb a taaba. B ra maanda sẽn yaa wẽng wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a Zeova bas tɩ Amõ nebã na n nams-⁠ba. La Israɛll nebã kelmame n yeel a Zeova yaa: ‘Tõnd kongame. D kotame tɩ f fãag tõndo.’

Israɛll nebã sũur sãama b beegrã yĩnga. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b lebg n tũud a Zeova, t’a Zeova me na n le sõng-⁠b yɛsa.

Yaa a Zɛfte la nebã yãk t’a na n lʋɩ b taoor tɩ b zab ne Amõ nebã. A Zɛfte ra rata ne a sũur fãa t’a Zeova sõng-⁠a. A pʋlma a Zeova yaa: ‘Fo sã n sõng maam tɩ m tõog Amõ nebã, mam sã n tɩ tõog n wa, ned ning fãa sẽn na n deng n yi m zakẽ wã n seg maamã, nin-​kãng yaa foo n so.’ A Zeova saka a Zɛfte sẽn yeelã n sɩd sõng-⁠a t’a tõog zabrã. A Zɛfte sẽn wa n kulã, yãmb mii ned ning sẽn yɩ pipi n seg-⁠a bɩ? Yaa a bi-​puglã sẽn da yaa a bi-​yendã. A Zɛfte sẽn yã-a wã a kelmame: ‘M ba ye! M biiga, fo waa ne sũ-sãoong n kõ-ma. Mam da pʋlma a Zeova. La m ka tõe n bas m noorã tɩ vaal ye.’

A Zɛfte bi-​puglã sẽn wʋm a ba wã sẽn pʋlem a Zeova bũmb ningã, a sũurã reng n sãamame. Bala a ra na n basa a zo-​rãmbã ne a ba wã n tɩ vɩɩmd Silo, n tʋm a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã a yõor tɛka. La a yeela a baaba yaa: ‘Yãmb sã n pʋlma a Zeova, y segd n pidsa y pʋlengã.’

A Zɛfte bi-​puglã kẽnga Silo n tɩ tʋm a Zeova sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ a yõor tɛka. La yʋʋmd fãa, Israɛll pagbã kẽngda a nengẽ n tɩ pẽg-⁠a la b sõs ne-⁠a rasem a naase. Israɛll nebã ra nonga a Zɛfte bi-​puglã, bala a ra tũuda a Zeova sõma.Bʋkaoodba 10:​6-⁠18; 11:​1-⁠40. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii rao ning sẽn tall pãng n yɩɩg nebã fãa wã yʋʋr bɩ? Yaa bʋ-​kaood a Samsõ. Yaa a Zeova n da kõ-a a pãngã. Nand t’a Samsõ rog menga, a Zeova yeela a Samsõ ma wã yaa: ‘Fo na n dɩka pʋg n dog bi-​ribl ka la bilfu. Yaa yẽ n na n fãag Israɛll nebã Filisti nebã nugẽ.’

Filisti nebã ra yaa nin-​wẽns sẽn vɩ Kanaã. B ra tara sodaas wʋsgo. B sodaasã ra namsda Israɛll nebã hal wʋsgo. Raar a yembre, a Samsõ ra wa n debda Filisti nebã nengẽ, n tek n seg bõn-​yẽeg sẽn kelemde. La a Samsõ kʋʋ bõn-​yẽegã ne a nusã bala. A kʋʋ Filisti neb wʋsg me.

A Samsõ wa n yãa pʋg-​sad a ye n nongẽ. Pʋg-​sadã yʋʋr la a Dalila. Filisti nanambsã yeela a Dalila t’a sã n tõog n wilg-⁠b bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Samsõ tar pãng wʋsg woto wã, bãmb ned kam fãa na n kõ-a-⁠la wanzuri ligd koeems tusr la koabga. Yaa ligdã la a Dalila ra rata. A ra pa nong a Samsõ ne Wẽnnaam nebã ye. A pẽdga a Samsõ n dat t’a togs-⁠a bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a tar pãng wʋsgã.



A Dalila wa n tõog n kɩtame t’a Samsõ na n togs-⁠a. A Samsõ yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Mam sẽn dogã tɛka, b zɩ n wõrs mam zugã zoobd ye. Mam yaa Nazireẽ, sẽn dat n yeel tɩ yaa Wẽnnaam n so maam m yõor tɛka. Mam sã n põng m zugã, mam pãngã na n sɛɛme.’

A Dalila sẽn paam t’a Samsõ togs-⁠a woto wã, a maaname t’a Samsõ gũs a karsã zugu, t’a bool ned t’a na n wa wõrs a zoobdã. A Samsõ sẽn wa n nekã, a mikame t’a pãngã boogame t’a lebg wa neb a taabã. Filisti nebã wa n yõk-⁠a lame n feo a ninã, n maan-⁠a b yamba.



Raar a yembre, Filisti nebã maana kibs kãseng n na n waoog b wẽnnaam a Dagõ. B kɩtame tɩ b yiis a Samsõ bãens roogẽ n tall-⁠a n wa tɩ b na n yaal-⁠a la b paoog-⁠a. La a Samsõ zoobdã ra paam n tobame. A Samsõ yeela bi-​ribl ning sẽn da tɛt-⁠a wã t’a sõng-⁠a t’a tik roogã tẽn-​sʋk lals a yiib nins sẽn zãad roogã. A Samsõ sẽn paam n ta lalsã zĩigẽ wã, a pʋʋsa a Zeova n yeel t’a kõ-a pãnga, n yaool n tik lalsã n kelem tɩ: ‘M na n lagma Filisti nebã n ki.’ Yaa Filisti neb tus a tãab n da be kibsã zĩigẽ. A Samsõ tika lalsã n tus ne a pãngã fãa tɩ siig n kell n kʋ-⁠b fãa.Bʋkaoodba sak 13 n tɩ tãag 16. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

BI-​KƖDG ning yãmb sẽn ne wã yʋʋr la a Sãmwɛlle. Rao ning sẽn tik a Sãmwɛll zugã yaa Israɛll maan-​kʋʋdb kãsma. A yʋʋr la a Eli. Yaa a Sãmwɛll ba a Ɛlkana la a ma a Ana n tall-⁠a n wa a Eli nengẽ.

A Sãmwɛll zemsa yʋʋm a naas bɩ a nu. La a na n zĩnda a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã ne a Eli la maan-​kʋʋdb a taabã. Bõe yĩng t’a Ɛlkana ne a Ana tall b bi-​kɩdg a Sãmwɛll t’a na n tɩ tʋm a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã. Bɩ d gese.

Yʋʋm a wãn sẽn deng rẽ, a Ana sũurã da sãama wʋsgo, bala a ra pa tar biig ye. A ra rata biig ne a sũur fãa. A Ana wa n kẽnga a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã n pʋʋs-⁠a n yeel yaa: ‘Zeova, ra yĩm m yell ye. Fo sã n kõ maam bi-​ribla, mam na n dɩk-⁠a lame n kõ foo a yõor tɛka.’

A Zeova kelga a Ana pʋʋsgã, la kiis a wãn poore, a roga a Sãmwɛlle. A Ana ra nonga a biigã, la a sẽn wa n ket n paoodẽ menga, a zãms-⁠a lame t’a bãng a Zeova. A yeela a sɩdã t’a Sãmwɛll sã n wa sigi, a na n tall-⁠a lame n kẽng sɛk-​roogẽ wã t’a tɩ tʋmd a Zeova tʋʋmã.

Yãmb pa ne a Ana ne a Ɛlkana sẽn sɩd tall a Sãmwɛll n wa sɛk-​roogẽ wã sɩda? A Sãmwɛll baaba ne a ma sẽn wub-⁠a sõma wã yĩnga, a sũura nooma a sẽn paam n na n tʋm a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã. Yʋʋmd fãa, a Ana ne a Ɛlkana wata sɛk-​roogẽ wã n waoogd a Zeova la b get b bi-​riblã. Yʋʋmd fãa me, a Ana wʋgda fu-​bil n wat n kõt a Sãmwɛlle.

A Sãmwɛll kell n tʋma a Zeova sɛk-​roogẽ wã, t’a Zeova la nin-​buiidã nong-⁠a. La a Eli kom-​dibli a Ofni ne a Fineyas ra yaa nin-​yoodo. B tʋma tʋʋm-​yood la b kɩt tɩ neb a taabã me kɩɩs a Zeova noyã. A Eli ra pa segd n le sak tɩ b yɩ maan-​kʋʋdb ye. La a pa maan woto ye.

Baa ne nebã sẽn da tʋmd tʋʋm-​yood sɛk-​roogẽ wã, a Sãmwɛll ka bas tɩ rẽ kɩt t’a bas n pa le tũud a Zeova ye. La sẽn mik tɩ yaa neb bilf bal n da nong a Zeova wã yĩnga, a Zeova sẽn da gom ne ned kaoosa wʋsgo. A Sãmwɛll sẽn wa n bɩ bilf n paase, bũmb n maane.

A Sãmwɛll wa n gõee daar a yembr sɛk-​roogã pʋgẽ, n wʋmd koɛɛg sẽn boond-⁠a. A sakame la a wudg n tɩ yeel a Eli yaa: ‘Yãmb sẽn bool maamã, m waame.’

La a Eli yeel-⁠a lame tɩ yẽ pa bool-⁠a, la a yeel-⁠a t’a lebg n tɩ gãande. A Sãmwɛll sɩd lebgame.

La koɛɛgã le boolame tɩ: ‘Sãmwɛll!’ T’a Sãmwɛll yik n zoe n kẽng a Eli nengẽ n tɩ yeel yaa: ‘Yamb sẽn bool maamã, m waame.’ La a Eli yeelame yaa: ‘M pa bool-⁠f ye, m biiga. Lebg n tɩ gãande.’ T’a Sãmwɛll le lebge.

La koɛɛgã leb n boola naoor a tãab-⁠n-​soab tɩ: ‘Sãmwɛll!’ A Sãmwɛll yikame n le zoe n ta a Eli nengẽ n yeel yaa: ‘Masã wã yẽ, yaa yãmb n bool maam.’ A Eli bãngame tɩ yaa a Zeova n da boond a Sãmwɛlle, t’a yeel a Sãmwɛll yaa: ‘Lebg n tɩ gãande. La koɛɛgã sã n le bool-⁠f bɩ f yeel tɩ: “Zeova, gom tɩ f tʋm-​tʋmdã kelgdame.” ’

A Zeova le bool-⁠a lame yɛsa, t’a Sãmwɛll leok wa a Eli sẽn togs-⁠a to-⁠to wã. A Zeova yeela a Sãmwɛll t’a na n sɩbga a Eli ne a kom-​dibli wã. Kaoosg zugẽ, Israɛll nebã wa n zaba ne Filisti nebã, t’a Ofni ne a Fineyas ki zabrã pʋgẽ. A Eli sẽn wʋm t’a kom-​dibli wã kiime wã, a lʋɩɩ tẽng t’a yublã kao tɩ yẽ me ki. Kell n yɩɩ wa a Zeova sẽn da yeelã bal kɛpɩ.

A Sãmwɛll bɩɩme, la yaa yẽ n yɩ Israɛll yaoolem bʋ-​kaooda. A sẽn wa n kʋʋlã, Israɛll nebã yeel-⁠a lame t’a yãk ned t’a yɩ b naaba. A Sãmwɛll sũurã pa yɩ noog ye, bala yaa a Zeova n da yaa b naaba.
